notes: Imported from COMBATRIG portable fleet. Resolve every blocking migration gap before approval.

domains.title: Enemy & friendly AI systems
scope: combat behaviour, squads, target selection, alert propagation
domains.legacy_notes: Keep new AI timers on dt and simRandom, never wall-clock setTimeout/Math.random — the QA replay diverges otherwise (ai-qa moved the garrison group alert onto EnemyController.alertIn for this reason).

domains.title: AI QA playtester
scope: the harness that plays the game: policies, sweeps, baselines, run bundles
domains.legacy_notes: COMBATRIG-ai-qa-base is its scratch checkout, detached on purpose. Runbook .agents/skills/ai-qa/SKILL.md. STANDING DUTY (owner, 2026-09-08): run continuously against what lands on main — play the affected contracts after a batch of landings, compare to the last sweep baseline, report regressions to the session that caused them and to the dispatcher. Its own backlog items are what it does between landings, not instead of them.

domains.title: AI writer & voice
scope: lore retrieval, writer prompt, voice register, Piper reader
domains.legacy_notes: Consumes what the lore session writes; agree file layout with them before pinning chunk counts.

domains.title: Animation & armature
scope: rig armatures and skinning, walk/run cycles, footfall, landing and recoil, torso/arm actuator motion, the recovery drone grapple and lift poses, the FSG unfold sequence, vehicle suspension — src/rigs/skeleton.ts and the gait/IK solver in rig.ts; ledger docs/ANIMATION-LEDGER.md
not_scope: chassis mechanics and specs (rigs-vehicles); mesh topology and hip assembly geometry (meshcraft/textures); camera framing and shake (camera-hud); footstep audio and the sound bank (audio/music); footDust emitters (particles)
domains.legacy_notes: Opened 2026-09-14 against the owner TODO line 'Next Rig presentation work: knee/ankle mechanics, footfall, landing and recoil feedback, following the mechanical leg standards already established for hips' (docs/TODO.md) and section 15 'footfall / machine-weight presentation'. Read docs/design/mechanical-hips.md before touching a joint: pivots are a CONTRACT the IK hardcodes (thigh (0,-0.2,0), knee (0,-2.0,bend*0.12), ankle (0,-1.42,bend*-0.07)) and a visual-only revision must not move them. rigs-14 closed the mass-carrying step NUMBERS (test:footfall); rigs-16 is the unproven LOOK and is still rigs-vehicles' ticket.

domains.title: Meshcraft mission assets
scope: the asset foundry, new meshcraft props for missions

domains.title: Music & sound effects
scope: music director, sfx events, mix, data/sfx/*.json
domains.legacy_notes: Owns the event ids other sessions fire (rig_destroyed vs explosion_large). npm run test:sfx checks every clip an event names exists.

domains.title: Browser issues
scope: load hangs, tab lifecycle, anything that breaks in a real browser

domains.title: Camera, player view & HUD
scope: chase camera, lens and framing, HUD

domains.title: Concept art — world plates and asset sheets
scope: docs/design/world-concepts/ (plates beside their prompts), per-asset concept plates and orthographic model sheets in docs/assets/<id>/, the prompt library and the rule that every image is answerable to a written intent; docs/CONCEPT-LEDGER.md
not_scope: geometry, textures, generation — a plate is an intent for someone else to build against, never a texture source
domains.legacy_notes: Created 2026-09-15. The fourteen world plates (asse-19) are the template. Concept-art-before-erosion (terr-15) is the owner's rule: this area is what satisfies it per world. First job: the deployed-bay plate for the Field Support Group and the Greenwell plates (the one world with none). Generation runs through tools/asset/genimage.mjs on the OpenRouter key in ~/.config/combatrig/secrets.env at about $0.039 a call — real spend on the owner's account, so confirm the subject list before a batch. What the generator does and does not respond to is measured and written down in docs/CONCEPT-LEDGER.md; read it before writing prompts, and record what each plate MISSED, because the next person builds from the picture and will otherwise build the miss.

domains.title: Controller & input design
scope: action map, gamepad, rebinding, Steam Input

domains.title: Gameplay adjustments
scope: feel and moment-to-moment play; currently the death camera and loss debrief
domains.legacy_notes: Despite the name it has touched no balance values — say so before assuming a collision.

domains.title: Lore & universe building
scope: factions, regions, timeline, in-world texts, data/codex

domains.title: Mission depth
scope: objectives, contract structure, mission entities

domains.title: Multiplayer
scope: dropship insertion, free-for-all, lobby liveness, src/net/identity.ts
not_scope: src/platform/ and Steam-managed identity — unclaimed, see steam

domains.title: New features
scope: UNDECIDED — awaiting the owner's choice. The owner has nothing in mind here (2026-09-08) and idle is an acceptable state; they will hear one pitch. The only unclaimed surface found is Editor Phase 2 (docs/COMBATRIG-Level-Map-Editor-Dev-Plan.md), which is a tool rather than something a player feels.

domains.title: Particle systems
scope: src/fx/particles.ts, emitters and channels
domains.legacy_notes: burst() takes a channel as its required FIRST argument: 'combat' for hits/impacts (reserved band), 'fire', 'ambient' for scenery.

domains.title: Performance optimizations
scope: frame cost, triangle budgets, measurement tooling (__combatrig.frameBreakdown, tools/test/shot.mjs)

domains.title: New rigs & vehicles
scope: rig chassis, vehicle driver, convoys, NavGrid planning

domains.title: Roadway, railway & city system
scope: road classes, rail, city and settlement layout, transportGraph
domains.legacy_notes: COMBATRIG-road-base is its scratch checkout, detached on purpose.

domains.title: Skybox & weather
scope: sky dome, atmosphere, weather states, terrain coupling

domains.title: Steam packaging & installers
scope: Electron desktop wrapper, Steamworks, per-OS installers, src/platform/
domains.legacy_notes: Multiplayer has no claim on src/platform/; treat src/net/identity.ts as the seam to adapt, not replace.

domains.title: Terrain & world design
scope: the landscape compiler, scatter, LOD, terrain-detail
domains.legacy_notes: perf measures terrain-detail as the single biggest frame owner (66-102k triangles, all cast into the shadow map). Owns the E5 field dressing and E6 furniture/pit kit PLACEMENT, and the weather channels: vegetationTint for plants and the structural weathering by KitSlot (c4b337a).

domains.title: Texture development
scope: materials, atlases, rig livery (src/canon/livery.ts), meshcraft surface work
domains.legacy_notes: The faction to insignia table is now one module, src/canon/livery.ts — import it, never copy it.

domains.title: Vegetation & world detail
scope: the authored prop kit (src/world/propKit.ts), field dressing, deadwood, pit gear
not_scope: the scatter/LOD path — coverArt.ts, cover cards, near ring, impostors, reaches belong to terrain
domains.legacy_notes: SHARED with terrain and the line is not where either roster entry implied (2026-09-09): terrain authored the PLACEMENT — the E5 field dressing (field-wall/gate/shed/trough) and the E6 furniture and pit kit (winch house, headframe, cart, belt, trestle) — and vegetation authored the KIT PARTS that replaced the primitives in those paths. Both are partly right about 'the prop kit'. Check the commit subjects before assuming a hand-off; git author cannot distinguish sessions on this box. The split confirmed by both sides: PARTS are vegetation's, PLACEMENT is terrain's — where a trough stands in a pasture, where a cart is left on a spur. Two exceptions worth carrying so nobody rediscovers them: the field gate's yaw and its width were placement fixes vegetation made, because the authored parts are what made the faults visible.

domains.title: Weapons development
scope: weapon systems, hit registration, boresight, src/weapons/

domains.title: Web UI / UX
scope: the site and in-game UI shell, dev page

domains.title: Story campaign — missions, dialogue, campaign production
scope: src/story/, data/story/, docs/story/, docs/STORY-LEDGER.md, src/audio/combatAwareDialogue.ts; story integration in schemas/mission.schema.json coordinated with mission-depth; Halden M1-3 qualification, migration and signed-history sync; the story-missions phase of the program (ai-s-6) and Phase 3 of the Field Service System with mission-depth
not_scope: General contract generation and Long War generator ownership (mission-depth); lore retrieval, writer prompts and Piper reader (ai-writers-voice); global audio bus/music (music); Rig mechanics and transport mesh ownership; unrelated src/main.ts sections; shared schema changes require coordination
domains.legacy_notes: Claude session, created 2026-09-15 to replace Astra (ChatGPT, out 2026-09-14). Read docs/agents/ASTRA.md for the history, docs/handoff/story-campaign-2026-09-14.md (item 6 corrected) and docs/design/story-campaign-development-plan.md. Ship-time data lives under data/story/, never docs/ (test:sessions holds it). Nothing authored lands without a generator hook (mission-depth accepts).

domains.title: Asset producer — the rig, vehicle and weapon pipeline
scope: per-asset dossiers under docs/assets/<id>/ and their stage order (spec -> concept plates -> model sheet -> mesh -> texture -> fx -> armature -> integration -> QA sign-off); the asset foundry workflow, tools/asset/ and .agents/skills/asset-foundry; the ASSET QUEUE order and each asset's acceptance; docs/ASSET-LEDGER.md
not_scope: geometry (meshcraft), surfaces (textures), effects (particles), armature and animation (animation), mechanics and chassis files (rigs-vehicles), weapon specs (weapons) — the producer sequences and signs off, it does not build
domains.legacy_notes: Created 2026-09-15. Owns the SEQUENCE and the dossier, not the parts: every asset has one dossier with one open stage at a time, an acceptance line per stage, and the producer is who says an asset is done. First job: the cockpit interior (asse-22) and the DS-6 dossier as the template; then the Field Support Group hulls (rigs-19) when phase 2 opens.

domains.title: Art Director
scope: how the game looks and reads on screen in the PS2 / early-2000s PC era: rulings on taste, review of every look-moving change before it lands, lore/STYLE.md, the shell design-system record, docs/design/ART-RULINGS.md
not_scope: no src/, no gates, no landing, no schedule; never photographs anything itself (asks the area for the frame)
domains.legacy_notes: Charter: docs/agents/ART-DIRECTOR.md. Created 2026-09-23 at the owner's ask. Rules on taste; the dispatcher rules on priority; the owner overrides either.

domains.title: Infantry & FPS gameplay (experimental)
scope: the on-foot experiment: src/player/infantry/*, infantry.html + src/infantryCourse.ts, the hangar walk (bayWalk), footImpact/cameraImpulse, the on-foot HUD and audio hooks, tools/test/infantry.mjs, docs/design/infantry-observer.md; the ?infantry=1 / walk=1 flags
not_scope: the rig game itself: rig controls and weapons (weapons, controller-input), the action map (controller-input owns the 'foot' context), sound pipeline (audio), hangar geometry (web-ui, assets), AI behaviour (ai-combat) — ask, do not edit
domains.legacy_notes: Created 2026-09-24 at the owner's ask. EXPERIMENTAL: the owner started it with cloud sessions (branch claude/clever-volta-0e65f1) to learn whether a battle is fun from 1.7 m; nothing here is committed to shipping. Everything stays behind flags, the rig game byte-identical with them off. Window 18 (landing the MVP behind flags) is New Features' until it lands; this area owns the experiment after that. Cloud twin works on cloud/infantry.

domains.title: Vehicle combat (experimental)
scope: the PLAYER driving and fighting from a ground vehicle (tanks, APCs, trucks, emplacement-mounted guns, any non-rig vehicle we add) behind a ?drive=1 flag: mount/dismount, the drive and turret controls, the vehicle HUD, damage from the crew seat, docs/design/vehicle-combat.md
not_scope: AI-driven vehicles, convoys and the vehicle driver/physics (rigs-vehicles — ask, reuse, never fork); rigs; aircraft (aircraft); the on-foot mount path (infantry owns the person, you own the seat)
domains.legacy_notes: Created 2026-09-24 at the owner's ask: "vehicle combat, basically any other vehicle we create in game … very experimental only". Everything behind flags; the rig game byte-identical with them off. Cloud twin on cloud/vehicle-combat.

domains.title: Aircraft (experimental)
scope: the PLAYER flying: VTOLs, gunships, the DS-6/Wayfarer class and anything airborne we add, behind a ?fly=1 flag: flight model, controls, the flight HUD, how the world holds up at altitude and speed (draw distance, terrain LOD, streaming, frame cost), docs/design/aircraft.md
not_scope: the AI dropship/pickup flight and its missions (gameplay, contracts, multiplayer), ship meshes (assets), ground vehicles (vehicle-combat), terrain LOD itself (terrain — measure and ask)
domains.legacy_notes: Created 2026-09-24, split from vehicle combat because flight stresses different systems: the world was built for ground-level speeds and sightlines, so altitude is a terrain/perf question first. Very experimental. Cloud twin on cloud/aircraft.
